title: route.config.json
description: Per-project configuration for the route plugin. Written to .claude/route.config.json by /route:init. Every key is optional: the hooks deep-merge this file over their own defaults, so a partial file is valid.

enabled.description: Whether this role may be dispatched. Default true.

version.description: Config format version. 2 is current. A file with no version key is a v1 file and /route:init will upgrade it in place.

prod.description: Repo-relative production-code locations. A trailing '/' means a directory prefix; anything else is a glob supporting **, * and ?.

test.description: Globs identifying test files, which builder may not write.

docs.description: Repo-relative directory holding the tracking records.

models.description: Per-role model override, passed as the Agent call's `model` parameter. Any alias or full model id is accepted; it is not validated against a live model list. CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, if set, outranks all of these.

bookkeeping.description: Tracking records. With enabled=false the plugin does model routing only: no scribe, no record class in the guard, no counts in the session brief.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name written into record timestamps, e.g. UTC or Asia/Taipei.

records.description: Record family -> its hot file and its archive, both relative to paths.docs.

keep.description: How many entries stay in the hot file before rolling to the archive.

openTaskPattern.description: Python regex, applied per task entry with re.MULTILINE. A match means the entry is still open.

roles.description: Per-role dispatch switch. A role with enabled=false is denied by the PreToolUse guard, dropped from the session brief's roster, and not offered by the route skill. Turning every role off leaves the plugin's guards and audit in place while the session does the work itself.

enabled.description: Legacy alias for roles.scout.enabled, kept so a v1 file keeps working. roles.scout.enabled wins when both are present.

artifacts.description: Language the agents write records and reports in, e.g. en or zh-TW. Code and identifiers stay in English regardless.

mainSeverity.description: What happens when the main session writes production code or a record.

readKB.description: Unbounded main-session Reads larger than this ask first. 0 disables the check.

scoutAt.description: Main-session discovery calls before the scout nudge. 0 disables it.

bashWriteDetection.description: Heuristic detection of filesystem writes issued through Bash. Best-effort by construction.

policy.description: always = review every builder round; risk = review when a trigger fires; never = the test is the only gate.

nudge.description: Whether a returning builder dispatch injects the review-policy reminder.

triggers.description: Replaces the skill's default risk triggers when present. Empty means no automatic risk trigger.

charsPerToken.description: Characters per token used by /route:delta. 4 suits English; CJK text is nearer 1.5. Calibrate with `dispatch_delta.py --validate`.

pricingFile.description: Path to a pricing table replacing the plugin's scripts/pricing.json. Relative paths resolve from the project root.
